events.body:
## Context

`public/screenshots.html` links to the forge but labels links "View ... on GitHub" with a GitHub icon. BLT-Nexus and BLT-Waypoint have no screenshot, while BLT-GitHub-App, BLT-on-Cloudflare and owasp-blt.github.io have orphan images. README says `cd blt-waypoint` right after cloning BLT.git.

## What to do

1. Change the label/icon to git.owaspblt.org (match `issues.html`).
2. Add the two missing PNGs and delete the orphans.
3. Fix the README `cd BLT/blt-waypoint`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No "on GitHub" label points at the forge
- [ ] Every repo with a homepage has a screenshot
- [ ] No orphan images

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-waypoint/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-waypoint
```

---
